requirement_or_question: SignaturePolicy::enforce evaluates bindings independently across all supplied signatures: any requirement with no signatures is ABSENT, any cryptographically invalid signature fails the whole set, and each required binding needs one VALID status from any signature, so CONTENT from one signer and PHYSICAL from another satisfy a policy no single signer met.
